turns.text: Don't just stick all the text in the bottom left corner. Let's also design some graphics to go along with each of the slides, except for the intro one.

Added a 'graphic' object to slides 2 through 6, each specifying a distinct visual element (icon grid, before/after shoulder diagram, quadrant watermark, dual gauge, vertical flowline) with placement and design description so a designer can execute them alongside the existing text layout.
